hero.title: Forge ranked teams from your own character pool.
hero.copy: Lock one or two leaders, add the subs you want available, and compare multiple legal teams ranked by distinct ability coverage.

roster.title: Leaders and candidate pool
roster.copy: Captains stay locked. Every other selected character becomes an eligible sub candidate for the ranked suggestions.
roster.minimum: Pick at least {{count}} unique characters across leaders and pool before generating teams.

leaders.captainEmpty: Leave this empty to let Crew Forge choose the best captain for the current roster.
leaders.friendEmpty: Leave this empty to let Crew Forge choose the best friend captain for the current roster.

pool.title: Sub pool
pool.empty: Add the characters you want Crew Forge to consider as possible subs.

imageImport.title: Image import
imageImport.copy: Upload a roster screenshot, match it against an exact resolution profile, and auto-fill the candidate pool from the recognized portraits.
imageImport.empty: Upload a screenshot to start profile-based portrait recognition.
imageImport.processing: Crew Forge is analyzing the uploaded screenshot...
imageImport.builtInCopy: This bundled default stays read-only. Edit, save-example, and exemplar learning create a local copy automatically.
imageImport.previewCopy: {{count}} unique characters are ready to replace the current pool.
imageImport.slotEmpty: No confident match yet for this slot.

learning.title: Save exemplars
learning.copy: Store confirmed slot crops on apply so future imports for this profile match faster.

picker.title: Choose portrait match
picker.copy: Override the current recognition result for this slot.

profileEditor.title: Profile editor
profileEditor.copy: Define the exact screenshot size, slot crop rectangles, and preprocessing used before fingerprint matching.
profileEditor.name: Profile name

errors.invalidType: Only image files can be imported.
errors.loadFailed: The screenshot could not be loaded.
errors.recognitionFailed: Crew Forge could not analyze this screenshot.
errors.noProfile: Create or select an exact resolution profile before recognition can run.
errors.profileMismatch: The selected profile does not match the current screenshot dimensions.
errors.noProfileForDimensions: No exact profile exists for {{width}} × {{height}}. Create one before running recognition.
errors.invalidProfile: The profile is incomplete. Fill in the name, dimensions, and slot rectangles.

catalog.title: Search and assign characters
catalog.copy: Use the filters below to browse your local dataset, then mark each character as captain, friend captain, or part of the sub pool.
catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search name, id, type, or class
catalog.empty: No characters match the current catalog filters.

filters.favoritesHint: Only affects the catalog picker, not already selected picks.

results.title: Ranked team results
results.copy: Each result keeps the locked leaders you selected and tries to maximize distinct utility across the full six-character team.
results.emptyState: Pick leaders and a candidate pool to start generating ranked teams.
results.empty: No valid teams could be assembled from the current roster picks.
results.loading: Crew Forge is evaluating the best team combinations...
results.noUniqueAbilities: No unique builder abilities were parsed for this team.
results.noDuplicateAbilities: This team does not duplicate any parsed builder abilities.
